title: Your Touch
lyrics: Verse 1:
[Gm]Staring at a blank wall a[Bb]nd all its white washed face
[C]Not knowing why I [Bb]had to choose this way
[Gm]I discern [B]I was wrong in my way
[C]Looking for peace in a[B]nother, another domain
Pre-Chorus 1:
[Eb]And I realize [F]that its true [Gm]I seek you, yes I seek you
[Eb]And I realize [F]that its true [G]I need you, yes I need you
Chorus 1:
[G]And I reach and I [B]touch you and I[F] know that I need you[Eb]
[G]To reach out and to [B]touch me and I [F]know
I know that I need [Eb]your touch
Verse 2:
[Gm]Not knowing why [Bb]I ever [C]retreated from your arms
[Bb]A mistake I made
[Gm]Now oh Lord I [Bb]feel your warm [C]embrace, contentment
fills my [Bb]soul as joy lights my face
Bridge 1:
[Dm]You Look into the sky
[Dm]and see His arms of love reaching out for you
[Dm]His arms of love and grace
[Dm]And you know you need him, you need his touch
[Dm]I need your, I need your.....touch
